title: Claims register
description: One row per public claim Strale has ruled on: allowed, needs evidence, forbidden, or retired. See docs/company/claims.yaml and archive/sessions/2026-09-02-t14-cheap-extras-plan.md (part C).

id.description: Short kebab-case id, unique within the register.

claim.description: The exact phrase, or a /regex/ (JS regex literal, case-insensitive match applied by the checker), that identifies this claim in prose.

is_regex.description: True when `claim` should be compiled as a regular expression rather than matched as a literal substring.

status.description: allowed: may ship as-is. needs_evidence: may ship only alongside working evidence (checker warns if `evidence` doesn't resolve). forbidden: must never appear on a scanned surface (checker fails the build). retired: no longer scanned for; kept for history.

evidence.description: A repo-relative path or a URL substantiating the claim. Required for status allowed and needs_evidence.

surfaces.description: Where this claim may (or historically did) appear — e.g. 'homepage', 'README', 'methodology page', 'llms.txt'. Free text; not machine-enforced per-surface, just documentation of scope.

decided_by.description: A DEC id, or 'founder-<YYYY-MM-DD>' for an undocumented founder call, or the audit document that ruled on it (e.g. a path into the claim-audit handoff).

note.description: Free-text context — why the ruling, what it replaced, what the correct qualified version looks like.
